purpose: Freeze which market-state bucket may define the conditioned arm before any conditioned strategy PnL is inspected, using only state semantics and execution rationale.

directionality_vs_chop.rationale: The frozen discovery-v1 logic is directional; the predeclared trial asks whether signals observed in a more directional future-state regime behave differently from the unconditional baseline.

volatility_expansion_contraction.rationale: The predeclared trial tests the state where expected movement is larger relative to a causal baseline, without changing fees, spread, slippage, latency or strategy definitions.

liquidity_stability_deterioration.rationale: The current qualified liquidity targets are future spread or spread-expansion measures, so a lower predicted target represents the predeclared more stable execution state.

signed_direction_or_continuation.rationale: Signed-return targets require a separately versioned side-aware interaction with long versus short signal direction; strategy-state-mapping-v1 does not infer or optimize that interaction.

trial_rules.conditioned_arm_rule: Keep only otherwise-valid frozen discovery-v1 signals whose current state feature falls in the single mapped raw feature bucket.
trial_rules.baseline_arm_rule: Use the same frozen discovery-v1 signals without the state bucket gate.
